set.body: Scope: use the supplied phase-resolved Wynn study and retrieval fixation tables as a provisional GazeWeave testbed while the independent Wang archive remains unavailable. Freeze and validate probe-only 0-500 ms, delay-only 500-3000 ms, and combined 0-3000 ms paths before outcome scoring; derive four study presentations without outcome filtering; compare Replay, Transport v2, registered density, nested MultiMatch, and elastic baselines under shared two-way folds and controls. Preserve GW-10: this same-parent-data court cannot establish independent replication or justify a universal default. Done when inputs have checksums/provenance, importer invariants and phase-splitting tests pass, the frozen court runs, and a bounded persistence verdict is recorded without post-result tuning.
set.title: GW-11 Run the Wynn probe-delay persistence court
